input: PASSAGE_STATE + immutable original + STEP-H candidate(s) + blinded comparative observations
rules: The evaluator may not consume writer rationale, writer quality claims, or generation-side declarations of superiority as authority.
Original and candidate identities are blinded during comparative judgment where practical.
Pairwise comparison is repeated with presentation order swapped where practical.
A position-dependent preference is bias evidence and cannot authorize candidate acceptance.
Hard preservation regressions veto literary preference.
Relevant dimensions are conditioned by passage purpose and adjudicated opportunity; no universal prose-quality scalar is permitted.
A candidate must demonstrate target improvement without unresolved critical non-target regression to displace the original.
Tied, contradictory, low-confidence, or materially incomplete evidence yields RETAIN_ORIGINAL or ABSTAIN_HUMAN_REVIEW.
The evaluator records tradeoffs rather than hiding them in one aggregate score.
Named-author similarity is not an evaluation target or quality proxy.
